Resolves a missing matrix parameter and performs nested substitutions.

## Signature

```typescript
liquidMethodMissing(key: string, context: liquidjs.Context): Promise<any>;
```

## Returns

Promise&lt;any&gt;

The resolved matrix parameter value.

## Exceptions

[TemplateError](/xpm-lib-ts/docs/api/xpm-lib/classes/templateerror) If the matrix parameter is not defined.

## Remarks

Called by the Liquid engine when a matrix parameter is accessed that doesn't exist as a regular method. This implements the Drop pattern for dynamic matrix parameter resolution.

Resolution process:

<ol> <li>Validate the parameter exists, throw <code>InputError</code> if not.</li> <li>Retrieve the parameter value (string, array, or object).</li> <li>If object, return as-is for Liquid to access nested properties.</li> <li>If array, join elements into a single string for processing.</li> <li>If the value contains Liquid syntax, recursively render it with the current context to resolve nested references.</li> <li>Return the final resolved value.</li> </ol>

This mirrors the behavior of [LiquidPropertiesDrop](/xpm-lib-ts/docs/api/xpm-lib/classes/liquidpropertiesdrop) but operates on matrix parameters instead of properties. Matrix values can reference other substitution variables, enabling complex template expansions.
